summary: The narratives show the verb through the reversal of an army’s fortunes. In Psalm 18 the lightning and arrows drive home the attackers’ loss of order.

senses.definition: Yahweh disorders the Egyptian camp at the sea and routs Sisera’s chariots before Barak. David uses the same verb after describing the lightning that scattered his foes.

note: The Jewish Aramaic verb הֲמַם for sweeping (Jastrow, Targum Isaiah 14:23) supplies little evidence for the Hebrew military sense. The Persian personal name Haman has a different final consonant.
